hits.title: Half-yearly complaints data: H2 2025 – Financial Ombudsman service
hits.snippet:
Date published: 22 July 2026   Business complaints data : Category   Complaints data : Category   H2 data : Category   Data and Insight : Category

We publish data every six months showing the number and outcome of the complaints we handle about financial businesses.

Our half-yearly data shows the number of complaints against financial businesses for which there were both 30 new and 30 resolved complaints in the relevant period. [...] As a one-off, this data covers 1 July 2025 to 31 March 2026 and applies to firms where the Financial Ombudsman received and resolved at least 45 complaints. The change reflects a new publication schedule, aligning this with other data releases. Future half-yearly data will cover April to September and October to March.

hits.title: Complaints data | FCA
hits.snippet:
# Complaints data

Transparency from firms on the number of complaints they receive is helpful for industry and consumers. Firms can compare their performance in the market and consumers have an additional source of information about the firms we regulate. Further complaints data may be obtained from the Financial Ombudsman Service.

15 May 2026 update

Following our investigation into a reporting anomaly in one firm’s complaints return, we have updated the H1 2025 and H2 2025 data. [...] Firm-specific data relating to Consumer credit complaints can be found on the Firm-level sortable tables under the 'Consumer credit' tab.

More information on how to use our complaints data.

## Making a complaint

If you are unhappy with a financial product or service received, please see how to complain.

## Future edition publication dates

H1 2026 data: 22 October 2026

H2 2026 data: 29 April 2027

View previous versions of the complaints data

## In this section

## Data [...] Firm specific complaints data

Our firm-specific complaints data set is composed of submissions from approximately 290 individual firms reporting either 500 or more complaints within a 6-month period, or 1,000 or more complaints annually. The data is available in 2 formats via 8 sortable tables that can be searched and filtered on at firm-level and a downloadable Excel file that can be filtered by 5 product groups.
